macros.name: IfJaHolidayF
macros.doc: The \IfJaHoliday(TF) tests are used to check if a date is a Japanese holiday or not.

macros.name: IfJaHolidayT
macros.doc: The \IfJaHoliday(TF) tests are used to check if a date is a Japanese holiday or not.

macros.name: jadayofweek
macros.doc: This command converts from a date to the name of week, i. e., one of 月, 火, 水, 木, 金, 土, 日. You can specify the arguments in exactly the same way as \jaholidayname.

macros.name: jaholidayname
macros.doc: This command is expanded to the name of Japanese holiday corresponding to the specified date, if it is a holiday.
